procedural_matters: AZE 27 is represented by Kamal Basirli.
The race committee is presented by Elena Papazogliu, IODA CR.
Panaglis Papadacis, Coach of AZE 27, attended the hearing as an observer.
Burcu Algon Giorgianni attended the hearing as interpreter for AZE 27.
facts: For the second start of race 2 for yellow fleet black flag was displayed as preparatory signal.
After the starting signal a general recall was displayed by the race committee.
AZE 27 sail number was posted by the race committee as being scored BFD.
The race was restarted and AZE 27 did not start.
Upon reviewing the records, the race committee found that AZE 27 had been misidentified.
conclusions: AZE 27s score in race 2 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by an improper action of the race committee. RRS 61.4(b)(1) applies.

AZE 27 is to be scored in race 2 points equal to the average, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of her points in all races in the qualifying series, except race 2. No other boat’s score shall change.
decision: Redress is given to AZE 27. AZE 27 is to be scored in race 2 points average points of her scores in the qualifying series, except race 2. No other boat’s score shall change.
